en: The postcard depicts the interior of a restaurant, likely built into or adjacent to a rocky cave wall. It shows several people, including two children and two adults, standing among tables and shelves stocked with bottles and other items. The setting is rustic, with the rock wall visible behind the restaurant furnishings. There is also a sign above the counter that reads 'Restaurantul.' The overall style and attire of the people suggest an early 20th-century scene. The lower part of the postcard contains printed Romanian text.
